i.norm: Adding a zero duration to a TaiInstant should be a no-op: the method returns the very same instance, leaving its seconds and nanos unchanged. The starting instant is built from ofTaiSeconds(-10, -10). The factory normalises the negative nanosecond adjustment so that nanos stay in the range 0..999,999,999, borrowing one second in the process: seconds = -10 + floorDiv(-10, 1_000_000_000) = -10 + (-1) = -11 nanos = floorMod(-10, 1_000_000_000) = 999,999,990
